fullTextZH: 你好，今天我要说说我的高中生活。
fullTextEN: Hello, today I want to talk about my high school life.

fullTextZH: 我的高中是一个很不错的高中，
fullTextEN: My high school is a pretty good high school,

fullTextZH: 可是我非常不喜欢我的高中生活。
fullTextEN: But I really don't like my high school life.
I feel that my high school life,
is almost like a nightmare.

fullTextZH: 所以今天我要说说七个方面，
fullTextEN: So today I want to talk about seven aspects,

fullTextZH: 为什么我不喜欢我的高中生活。
fullTextEN: why I don't like my high school life.
The first is that in my school,
everyone has a number.

fullTextZH: 这个号码其实是你的成绩排名。
fullTextEN: This number is actually your grade ranking.
At the start of the school year,
everyone has to take an exam,

fullTextZH: 然后根据你的成绩来排名。
fullTextEN: and then rank according to your grades.
If you are first place,
your number is 1.
If you are fifth place,
your number is 5.
I remember in my class,
there were a total of 60 people,
and then my number was 56.
So my grades are not good.

fullTextZH: 然后每个人都有很多本子，
fullTextEN: Then everyone has many notebooks,

fullTextZH: 你要在你的本子上写你的号码。
fullTextEN: You need to write your number on your notebook.
For example, I am 56,
Then I need to write 56.

fullTextZH: 所以所有的人都会知道我的成绩不好，
fullTextEN: So everyone will know my grades are not good,

fullTextZH: 因为他们可以看到我的号码是56。
fullTextEN: Because they can see my number is 56.

fullTextZH: 所以每次别人看到我的号码56，
fullTextEN: So every time others see my number 56,
I always feel very embarrassed.

fullTextZH: 第二个是在我的学校，我们有好班，
fullTextEN: The second is at my school, we have advanced classes,
and also regular classes.

fullTextZH: 高一的时候，我在一个好班，
fullTextEN: In the first year of high school, I was in an advanced class,
but my grades were average.

fullTextZH: 然后我觉得我的同学都很聪明，
fullTextEN: Then I felt my classmates were all very smart,
but I was very dumb.

fullTextZH: 所以我的压力非常非常大。
fullTextEN: So my pressure was extremely high.

fullTextZH: 我觉得我很努力很努力，
fullTextEN: I felt I worked very hard,

fullTextZH: 可是我的成绩还是不好。
fullTextEN: but my grades were still not good.
At the end of the first year of high school,
If your grades are not good,
You need to go to the regular class.

fullTextZH: 所以我当然去了普通班。
fullTextEN: So of course I went to the regular class.
In the advanced class, I was 56,
In the regular class, I was 12.

fullTextZH: 在好班，我觉得我真的不聪明，
fullTextEN: In the advanced class, I felt I was really not smart,
I was really very dumb.
But in the regular class,

fullTextZH: 我觉得我还可以，不那么笨。
fullTextEN: I felt I was okay, not that dumb.

fullTextZH: 在中国，有的人喜欢做“凤尾”，
fullTextEN: In China, some people like to be the 'phoenix tail',
Some people like to be the 'chicken head'.

fullTextZH: 现在我觉得我宁可做鸡头，
fullTextEN: Now I feel I would rather be the chicken head,
Not be the phoenix tail.

fullTextZH: 因为我觉得做一个鸡头，
fullTextEN: Because I feel being a chicken head,
Will make you feel happier.
Thirdly, every exam,
The teacher would post the grades,
On the wall.
In this way,

fullTextZH: 所有的人都知道你的成绩。
fullTextEN: Everyone knows your grades.

fullTextZH: 有的老师甚至会读你的成绩，
fullTextEN: Some teachers even read your grades,
Everyone's grades.
For example: 'First place, Mary,'
Second place, Mark,
Third place, David.'
If your grades are good,
Of course, you are very happy.

fullTextZH: 可是如果你的成绩不好，
fullTextEN: But if your grades are not good,
The feeling is,

fullTextZH: 而且在中国，我们常常考试，
fullTextEN: Moreover, in China, we often have exams,
Almost once a month.

fullTextZH: 所以如果你的成绩不好，
fullTextEN: So if your grades are not good,

fullTextZH: 你每个月都要被羞辱一次。
fullTextEN: You get humiliated once a month.
Very, very embarrassing.
Fourth,

fullTextZH: 在我的高中，我们要学习很多个科目。
fullTextEN: In my high school, we had to study many subjects.

fullTextZH: 我记得在高一，我们要学习，
fullTextEN: I remember in the first year of high school, we had to study,
Math, Chinese, foreign languages,
And,

fullTextZH: 物理、化学、地理、历史、政治。
fullTextEN: Physics, chemistry, geography, history, politics.
Whether you like it or not,
You have to study eight subjects.

fullTextZH: 高二的时候，你要决定你要学习，
fullTextEN: In the second year of high school, you have to decide what you want to study,
liberal arts or sciences.

fullTextZH: 我觉得文科理科都很无聊，
fullTextEN: I think both liberal arts and sciences are boring,

fullTextZH: 可是没有办法，我要决定一个。
fullTextEN: but there's no choice, I have to decide on one.
I think liberal arts are extremely boring,

fullTextZH: 因为你要背很多很多东西。
fullTextEN: because you have to memorize a lot of things.

fullTextZH: 可是理科，你不用背很多东西，
fullTextEN: But in sciences, you don't have to memorize a lot,
you have to think a lot.
So I chose to study sciences,
although I hate physics the most.
But there's no choice,
I must choose one.
I chose sciences.

fullTextZH: 所以高二高三，我要学习，
fullTextEN: So in the second and third year of high school, I have to study,
math, Chinese, English,
physics, chemistry,
and a new one, biology.
Whether you like it or not,
you have to study this much.
The fifth one is,
The study time is very, very long.
We have to study from 8 AM to 12 PM,
then at 12 you eat,
take a nap.
Then start studying from 2:15 PM to 5:50 PM.
Then you go have dinner,
maybe you go exercise,
maybe you go shower.
But if you live at school,
you still have evening self-study.

fullTextZH: 就是所有的人还在教室，
fullTextEN: That means everyone is still in the classroom,
studying on their own.
Evening self-study is from 7 PM to,
10 PM.

fullTextZH: 所以每天我们要学习十几个小时，
fullTextEN: So every day we have to study for more than ten hours,
very, very tiring.
The sixth one is,
the school prohibits dating.
I didn't date,

fullTextZH: 有一次我和我的朋友一起走，
fullTextEN: Once, my friend and I were walking together,
He is a guy.

fullTextZH: 然后有一个老师看到我们一起走，
fullTextEN: Then a teacher saw us walking together,
This teacher was very angry.
He said, 'What are you doing?'

fullTextZH: 我们说：“我们没有做什么，
fullTextEN: We said, 'We are not doing anything,
we are just walking together.'
So at my school,

fullTextZH: 老师不喜欢看到你谈恋爱，
fullTextEN: teachers don't like to see you dating,

fullTextZH: 因为老师觉得如果你谈恋爱，
fullTextEN: because teachers think if you date,
you might not study well.
The seventh thing is, at my school,
everyone has to cut their hair,
cut it very, very short.
For example, you can't do this,
this is not allowed.
You can't cover your eyebrows,
this is also not allowed,

fullTextZH: 因为不可以遮住你的耳朵。
fullTextEN: because you can't cover your ears.
So it has to be very, very short.

fullTextZH: 有的人真的不喜欢短头发，
fullTextEN: Some people really don't like short hair,

fullTextZH: 所以如果她的头发很短，
fullTextEN: so if her hair is very short,
she cries, but there's nothing she can do.

fullTextZH: 每个人都要剪很短很短的头发。
fullTextEN: Everyone has to cut their hair very, very short.

fullTextZH: 还有一个是，每个人从星期一到星期五，
fullTextEN: Also, everyone from Monday to Friday,

fullTextZH: 我们都要穿学校的衣服，
fullTextEN: we all have to wear school clothes,
which are uniforms.

fullTextZH: 你不可以穿自己的衣服，
fullTextEN: You can't wear your own clothes,
but you can on Saturday and Sunday.

fullTextZH: 可是星期一到星期五一定要穿校服。
fullTextEN: But from Monday to Friday, you must wear uniforms.

fullTextZH: 我觉得学校要我们剪头发还有穿校服，
fullTextEN: I think the school wants us to cut our hair and wear uniforms,

fullTextZH: 因为学校希望我们好好学习，
fullTextEN: because the school hopes we study well,

fullTextZH: 不要浪费时间在你的头发，
fullTextEN: and not waste time on your hair,
on your clothes.
Also, in my school,
some students have money,
some students don't have money.
If everyone wears uniforms,
then no one can compare.
And if you don't have money,
You won't feel very inferior.

fullTextZH: 所以其实我喜欢这个规定。
fullTextEN: So actually, I like this rule.
Finally, I want to say,

fullTextZH: 虽然我真的不喜欢我的高中生活，
fullTextEN: Although I really didn't like my high school life,
But,

fullTextZH: 我的高中老师还有我的同学都很好。
fullTextEN: My high school teachers and classmates were all very good.

fullTextZH: 现在他们还是我最好的朋友。
fullTextEN: Now they are still my best friends.

fullTextZH: 你呢？你的高中生活怎么样？
fullTextEN: What about you? How was your high school life?
Was it stressful?
Or very relaxed?
Leave a comment and tell me.
Then we'll see each other next time.
Thank you, bye-bye.
